title: HOW ANNA'S HUMMINGBIRDS GROW FROM NEST TO PERCH
caption: From nest care to adult perches and feeders: Anna's hummingbirds change fast. Separate archival birds, not one continuous life story. #AnnasHummingbird #Birds #Wildlife #WildVox

narration_timeline.text: This tiny Anna's hummingbird is beating its wings before it can even leave the nest.
narration_timeline.scene: Real nestling practicing wingbeats in the nest, no invented first flight.

narration_timeline.text: While it is still small, an adult returns to the nest with food as the chick grows stronger.
narration_timeline.scene: Separate fledgling perched and adult feeding a nestling, not one continuous individual.

narration_timeline.text: Adult Anna's hummingbirds often pause on thin branches between fast trips through their territory.
narration_timeline.scene: Two actual Anna's hummingbirds perched among branches, no unshown hovering claim.

narration_timeline.text: At flowers and feeders, rapid wingbeats let them hover while taking a drink.
narration_timeline.scene: Real Anna's hummingbird drinking at a feeder; crop only embedded side padding.

narration_timeline.text: Even in wet weather, they may sit and wait between feeding trips.
narration_timeline.scene: Authentic Anna's hummingbird perched during wet weather; no synthetic rain.

narration_timeline.text: From a tiny nestling to an adult perched high above, the same species changes quickly as it grows.
narration_timeline.scene: Archival adult Anna's hummingbird perched on bare branches; not the earlier nestling.
